prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each from a different look, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: American, in her mid 50s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term multiples pregnancy. Her pregnant belly is exceptionally wide as well as high, stretched into a broad, taut, smoothly rounded dome far wider than an ordinary single pregnancy, the navel pushed flat and outward at its highest point, faint linea nigra running down its centre. A full heavy bust above it, wide round hips below, soft thick thighs and arms. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive rounded middle. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, sun-kissed skin, heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, shimmery bronze eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline, a confident, camera-ready smile, deep dark brown hair styled in low bun, real pores, real living eyes, 150 studs piercings set with pearls in rose-gold-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of platinum a bracelet. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 vertical bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 31% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 68% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID PEARL WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC CYAN scale formations, VIVID GOLD scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, dragon phoenix formations in ELECTRIC GOLD and CRIMSON, extreme high-gloss oil finish. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, her extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Her figure is divided into 3 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 44% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 2 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 21% and 54% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries UV-reactive neon bodypaint, invisible under standard light but fractal energy burst formations in ELECTRIC GREEN and GOLD glowing at full intensity under her own dedicated UV blacklight. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID PLATINUM scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries applied ELECTRIC MAGENTA leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID SILVER undertone glinting through the thinnest points. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed. A standard hard key light illuminates most of her body; a separate dedicated UV blacklight illuminates the UV-reactive region specifically, making it glow at full intensity while the rest reads under normal light.

Environment: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient.
All: Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition, realistic photographic grain on the realistic-skin and pregnant women, extreme high-gloss oil on the darkest-skin women.
